name: TVS Holdings Ltd
about: Sundaram Clayton Ltd was incorporated in Chennai in 1962 and is part of the TVS group, led by Mr. Venu Srinivasan. It is engaged in the business of manufacturing and distributing aluminum die castings. [1] Sundaram Clayton manufactures non-ferrous gravity and pressure die castings.
keyPoints:
Brand Reputation
TVS Holdings Limited (Formerly known as Sundaram Clayton Limited) is one of the largest auto components manufacturing and distribution groups in India. TVSH is a leading supplier of aluminum die castings to the automotive and non-automotive sectors. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 25.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 19.4%
cons: Stock is trading at 5.36 times its book value
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
